notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Dargo for {R}.
description:
Cast Dargo by paying {R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Dargo dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
